content: Me niŋ Bepaŋdi tubulodawek yoŋa kutinilak
Yahwe Bepaŋ, du nehitubu-lodalaŋ eŋ kotigoŋ nanagitaŋ. Hadapmo nehitubu-lodaweŋ yoŋa kutiganilat, tiŋa undugoŋ timiŋ maaŋ ganinadi tilat.
Yonadine nadiweŋ, tiŋa nehitubu-lodadok kutiganilat u nadinambeŋ.
Malabumuŋ fee hinek mintanambune wendogoŋ tiŋa muniniŋ agaŋ kumundok tilat.
Nu me nolidi kumuŋ tine tiiŋ wendok tuwot, saŋiniŋne hogohogok agaŋ dapmahinaka tilak.
Nu binabune me kumuhi dut hatat. Nu adi me nolidi me niŋ ulukumuŋa tukulune meyotneŋ hatak undiniŋ. Nu adi me agaŋ nadikaule tiyemiŋa kotigoŋ tuwot mu yehitubu-lodalaŋ nabugoŋ.
Du agaŋ nehitukulune koŋ fuliŋmamaŋ gineŋ folat, tiŋa kwet mambipnit hinek gineŋ duwaŋ hatat.
Kwihitagedi imeŋgwaŋ wapum nabugoŋ nehikufula tiŋa nehitifohinaka tilak.
Dagoŋ tubune notneye adi sigilulum tinamgiŋ. Dagoŋ tilaŋ kaŋ nu kadakadapmaŋ hinek tibene nabuŋa munta kisaŋ hinek tiiŋ. Wendi kamehenamulak doktiŋa tuwot mu momoŋ wit.
Nu malabumuŋ hekiŋa daune kadakaune dau diwediwe momooŋgoŋ mu tilat. Unduŋ tiŋa helemahelemaŋ, Yahwe, du nehitubu-lodaweŋ yoŋa kohone kwehene-belooŋ yonadi kwanai tilat.
Du meeniŋ agaŋ kumuŋ tiiŋ u yehitubu-lodadok kunumneniŋ kudi maaŋbe tilaŋ? Meeniŋ kumuhi adi pilali ganiutumba maaŋbe tiiŋ?
Meeniŋ agaŋ meyotneŋ koŋ gineŋ deihakiiŋdi du adi welegedi yabukahile hinek tilaŋ wendok maaŋbe yohautaiŋ? Be meeniŋ kadaka titiŋdok kwetneŋ hakiiŋdi momooŋ tiyemguŋdok maaŋbe yohautaiŋ?
Meeniŋ meyotneŋ hakiiŋ adi kunumneniŋ kudi tilaŋ u maaŋbe kaiŋ? Kaŋ meeniŋ kadakadok kwetneŋ hakiiŋ adi du’walaŋ titiŋge momooŋ u maaŋbe kaiŋ?
Yahwe, nu du nehitubu-lodaweŋ yoŋa kutiganilat. Helemahelemaŋ haniŋ hogohogok du ganinadilat.
Kaŋ Yahwe, du maŋgande sigilulum tinamulaŋ? Tiŋa undugoŋ, maŋgande namandake kufulahebi tiŋa wooŋ hataŋ?
Me kuyane gineniŋ tububihila labuŋa kobuk i hatilat, woŋ adi folofigita hogok nadige nadige agaŋ kumuŋ tibe nadilat. Du malabumuŋ kisaŋ hinek nambune wendi kitiline agaŋ tubugweheye tilak.
Kwihitage wapum hinek wondi nehikufula tilak. Du kisaŋgoŋ hinek nulaŋa nehitubu-kadakadapmaŋ tilaŋ.
Du hadapmo be timiŋ adi unduŋ hogok tinamulaŋ. Kaŋ ime gabuŋ tiŋa kwetkwet hefula tilak unduŋ malabumuŋ hogohogokdi nehikelemadi tiiŋ.
Du unduŋ tubune me notneye momohi adi binabu tiiŋ. Kaŋ mambip gineŋ hogok hatilat.
